$description: Navigation and data: sidebar, site top bar, breadcrumb, pagination, tabs, table and calendar. DECIDED 13 Oct 2026 (approved on the review board, F-D072 to F-D075), first shown in round 7. Sizes and the few surface steps these components need; every colour points at an existing role. Built into --ui-<group>-<key> by node tools/tokens/build.mjs.

width.description: The expanded app sidebar on the layer behind the page.

width-icon.description: The collapsed icon rail: 44 px rounded squares (radius item) with 12 px of the layer behind on each side (68 px). Square, not round: Fume's rail (Marcus, 13 Oct).

width-mobile.description: The sidebar as a glass drawer on a phone; never wider than the screen minus 56 px, so the page stays in view behind the scrim.

row.description: A navigation row, 40 px; 44 on touch screens. The current row comes forward to Porcelain (--ui-behind-active) with --ui-depth-raised.

gap.description: The layer behind that shows around the page sheet (8 px). No stroke between the sidebar and the page: the sheet lies on the layer with --ui-depth-sheet.

logo.description: Height of the Fume logo (the lockup) in the sidebar header: 103 px wide, above the 96 px minimum, the word as large as the old 18 px wordmark. Logo before mark before wordmark (F-D080).

logo-mark.description: Height of the mark alone when the sidebar folds to the rail: the logo becomes its icon.

height.description: The site top bar: 40 px controls with 12 px of air above and below (64 px).

link.description: A link in the top bar: a 36 px quiet pill, 44 to touch.

logo.description: Height of the Fume logo (the lockup) in the top bar: 103 px wide, above the 96 px minimum. Logo before mark before wordmark (F-D080).

panel.description: Width of a top-bar dropdown: glass, radius float, rows with a title and one line of text.

gap.description: Between a crumb and its chevron separator (4 px); the chevron is the only divider, never a slash or a line.

size.description: A page button: a 40 px circle (two digits stay round), 44 to touch. The current page is Ink.

row-gap.description: Space between rows (4 px). Rows are told apart by space and the hover surface, never by lines (few-strokes).

row-hover.description: A row under the pointer: one step toward Ink on Porcelain.

row-selected.description: A selected row: the faint Amber wash of color.selected, light on what you chose (round 10; round 9 had Amber 50, round 8 two steps toward Ink). The checkbox itself is Ink.

cell-x.description: Air sideways in a cell (12 px); the first and last cell keep --ui-inset-float (16) from the row's rounded ends.

cell-y.description: Air above and below a cell (8 px).

head.description: Header row height (32 px): label type in tertiary, sticky on scroll.

thumb.description: Width of the creative thumbnail in a row (40 px, 4:5, so 50 tall), with the creative's hairline edge.

day.description: A day: a 40 px circle. Selected is an Ink circle; on glass a Porcelain one.

cell.description: A day's cell and hit area, 44 px. Narrow screens let the cells shrink and keep the 44 px hit area.

range.description: The band between the two Ink ends of a range: the faint Amber wash of color.selected (round 10; round 9 had Amber 50, round 8 the sunken step); no outline.

range-on-glass.description: The band of a range on glass: the clear veil, one step up.

today.description: Today: a small Ink dot under the date (Porcelain on a selected day). A dot, not a ring, so nothing draws a line.

gap.description: Between the tab list and its panel (16 px).

vertical-width.description: The vertical tab list on a settings page: a sunken track with one white pill that slides, like the segmented control.
